title: content/mail/mail.json
description: The authored inbox templates (28 Part A). What is fixed here is that a template is a loc key, a category out of the closed six, a title key, and a closed list of typed parameters — so a message is an authored template with typed parameters and never free text. additionalProperties is false on every object, so a field nobody declared is a build failure rather than a value the sender silently drops. ⚠️ The category enum carries all six values while the shipped document uses five: MILESTONE has no template, because nothing in this build sends one and authoring copy for a sender that does not exist is the plausible-looking hole this repository refuses. The enum is the vocabulary, not the inventory.

locKey.description: loc.<domain>.<id>.<field>, lowercase, dot-separated, snake_case segments — the same shape schema/loc.schema.json governs the locale files by.

paramName.description: A parameter's name, as the template's own text spells it in braces. Lower camel case, because that is how the design set's own example writes them.

templates.description: 🔒 The closed list of what ops may send. A send names a template id from this list; there is no arm anywhere that takes a body.

body.description: The body's loc key, and the template's identity — it is the key the message row stores, so a template renamed is a template every stored message stops resolving; rename by adding the new one and letting the old messages expire. ⚠️ Deliberately NOT named `id`: ContentInvariants reads an `id` member under a prefixed pattern as declaring an id SPACE, and doing that to the loc-key pattern would make every loc key in the whole content set resolve against this file's six — 917 orphaned references, measured.

category.description: Which of the six kinds a message from this template is sent as. Fixed by the template rather than chosen at send time: the category decides whether a message ever expires and whether the capacity rule may prune it, and an operator picking that per send would be an operator deciding whether a sanction notice is permanent.

title.description: The subject line's loc key. Separate from the body because a list groups by subject and a body is a paragraph.

params.description: The typed parameters the template's text expects. An empty list is legal and means a template that reads the same for everyone. A send must supply every one of these and nothing else.

type.description: TEXT is any non-blank string; INTEGER must parse as a whole number invariantly; DATE_UTC must parse as an ISO-8601 instant. The three exist so a send that would render 'Servers were unavailable for  hours' is refused by the tool rather than by 300,000 players.
